    "Independent read-only review of C24 attempt-02. No application/source changes, build/test reruns, application launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. Only this verdict is written.     "The two prior required fixes are resolved in the inspected implementation: diagnostic fields are checked against known application values or constrained version/source-location formats on recording and reading/export; failed clears report failure and recount retained events. Production-interface tests and mutation guards cover token-shaped and single-word values, external panic locations, retained files and retry. Compared the current inventory with the prior C24 attempt and accepted C23 snapshot.",
    "Recorded evidence passes 21 check/setup/shared commands, 9 test/setup commands and 3 native-preparation commands, including the core/host suites, 421 desktop frontend tests, 1362 shared presentation tests and 7 native_quality tests. All 7 C24 native checks and 259 C01-C23 regression checks report pass against executable 13b9bb6dd0bafa0a2b2105ac6ca9dd0a584d66f4d1d1fa9a8174cad7e54a4f8e.",
    "The prior native-interaction gap is resolved by C24-N07: keyboard export through the production NSSavePanel, saved-file/schema checks, cancellation without another export, focus returned to Export diagnostics after save and cancel, keyboard clearing, 200% zoom and minimum-size reachability. The button focus fix has a React regression and mutation guard. The changed shared native-sheet helper is exercised by the cumulative C10/C11/C12/C21 checks. Spoken VoiceOver output was not recorded or listened to; AX semantics and keyboard/focus paths were inspected.",
    "The startup/reconnect inventory now samples the app and newly appeared WebKit GPU, Networking and WebContent processes; both windows recorded three WebKit processes and zero sockets. Synthetic service requests on reconnect were zero, and seeded secret/content and Node-runtime scans reported no hits. Sampling every 0.5 seconds is not a packet capture: short-lived connections, pre-existing shared WebKit processes and DNS through mDNSResponder are outside what this method establishes.",
    "Independently recomputed all seven core/footprint metrics and 47 workload metrics across ten workloads against registered hashes, sample counts, units and limits; all pass. I reaffirm the version 4 acknowledgment for cold process launch of an already assessed installed copy, with first-copy launches retained separately. Current installed-copy cold p95 is 745.102 ms and warm p95 is 564.079 ms; first-copy p95 is 4105.632 ms and maximum 4956.830 ms. This does not establish a sub-two-second first installation launch. The supplied XProtect diagnosis was not independently reproduced.",
    "I explicitly acknowledge budgets.json version 5, SHA-256 85a441678b4108a2959fb875b72cfd10b7f524b6ef2c7ba16a08d5bf6211fab4, for the complete production package. Registration predates its measurement; the limits derive from the original 150/100 MiB allowances plus the pinned engine's 344345483 resource bytes and 113493748 archive bytes, rounded up to 479/209 MiB. Prior incomplete footprint results remain preserved. Independently verified the archive, all 1617 resource-inventory file hashes plus MANIFEST.json, resource digest, pinned executable, full app-tree and DMG hashes. The measured full production app is 363.996 MiB and DMG 124.284 MiB, resolving the prior package-evidence gap.",
    "Native workflow and performance evidence uses fixture builds, staged data and synthetic loopback services. The separately verified footprint uses the production configuration with the sealed Harness engine. License/notice and Node-free artifact checks are established; no pinned vulnerability-advisory scan is claimed. The version 0.2.0 precursor source freeze follows acceptance. Real-product qualification, signed/notarized installed packages and update/rollback validation remain C25/C26 scope; this verdict does not establish those future results."
  ],
